sourceFacts.fact: Prostaglandins help maintain afferent arteriolar dilation, particularly when renal perfusion is reduced.
Loss of this support can reduce filtration in a volume-depleted patient.

Tile3 a down arrow beside the label only; do not draw a narrowing vessel. Tile4 a neutral falling gauge, no kidney. Below the row print: Less prostaglandin support when perfusion is vulnerable.
